caption: The drawing features a symmetrical vessel with two large, curving handles, one on each side, rendered in black lines on an off-white background. The body of the vessel is wide and rounded, narrowing slightly near the base, which is depicted as a short pedestal. Each handle extends outward and curls inwards with decorative spiral flourishes, both ending in small loops. Above the body, between the handles, appears an inscription consisting of the characters "I R" separated by a small star-like symbol and flanked above by short lines and marks. Near the bottom right of the drawing, the name "Lawrence Flynn" is written in cursive script. The overall composition is centered on the page, and the black linework is evenly weighted, with no shading or color variations apart from the natural color of the paper.
title: Silver Caudle Cup
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
